size_pct_nav_at_cost: Entire position sold; original purchase exceeded 3.1 million shares; loss reduced all-fund YTD returns by four percentage points.

drivers.driver: Subscriber-growth changes have an outsized effect on intrinsic value because of operating leverage.

drivers.driver: Advertising and account-sharing changes may be sensible but are difficult to forecast.

entry_valuation_stated: No precise entry multiple in January announcement; the exit was about forecast dispersion, not a price target.
